convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMACD indicator with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, and no external dependencies. All logic is straightforward and maps directly to Python equivalents.
custom_logic_notes: Classic Simple MACD EA. Opens buy when MACD histogram crosses from negative to positive (main line crosses above signal line on previous completed bar). Opens sell when MACD histogram crosses from positive to negative. Signal reversal closes existing opposite position before opening new one. Entry signals evaluated on bar [1] vs [2] to avoid repainting. Default SL=300 points, TP=600 points with no digit adjustment.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas TA library or manual EMA calculation for MACD. Entry signals use completed bar data (shift=1 vs shift=2) so no repainting concern. SL/TP are in points (not pips) — note whether target platform uses pips or points for placement. No digit adjustment needed as SL/TP are applied directly via _Point multiplication. Position check ensures only one position at a time. New bar detection via time comparison is standard and easy to replicate.
